note.p: Sandbox and live credentials are separate. Never use live credentials in sandbox API calls or vice versa.
All API requests must use HTTPS. Requests over HTTP are rejected with a 301 Moved Permanently redirect.
Refunds must be issued within 180 days of the original capture. After 180 days, contact the buyer directly to arrange an alternative refund method.
Use the PayPal-Request-Id header on all POST requests. PayPal returns the cached response for duplicate requests with the same ID, preventing duplicate charges on retries.
Cache the access token and reuse it until 5 minutes before expiry. Generating a new token per request degrades performance and may trigger rate limits.
Always log the debug_id from error responses. Include it when contacting PayPal Developer Support to enable rapid root-cause analysis.
Use the PayPal Developer Dashboard to send test webhook events without completing a real transaction. Navigate to Webhooks → Simulate.

body.p: A valid OAuth 2.0 Bearer token — see .
All transactions in sandbox are simulated. No real money is transferred.
